peg_scene_mjcf — DRIVE pegsim op

• Data kinds: table → any

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.peg_scene_mjcf(kp=None, lg: 'float | None' = None, offsamples: 'int' = 4, timestep: 'float' = 0.0005) -> 'str' (to call the implementation directly, import pegsim; pegsim.peg_scene_mjcf(kp=None, lg: 'float | None' = None, offsamples: 'int' = 4, timestep: 'float' = 0.0005) -> 'str'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("peg_scene_mjcf"))

Usage

MJCF string of the scene (no mujoco needed): hole = a ring of n_seg boxes whose inscribed surface has radius R + a ring for the 45° chamfer + a collar at the mouth surface + a square frame; a position-controlled carriage (x, y, z slides) carrying a compliant wrist of 6 spring joints, with the peg (cylinder) at its end. The wrist camera looks 45° down from 60 mm behind and 20 mm above the carriage; the side camera is fixed.

lg = distance from the tip to the rotational compliance centre (None → wrist origin = peg length, 0 → centre at the tip = RCC). offsamples is MSAA (4 for RGB, compiled separately with 0 for depth — trap: depth would come from the position of sample 0). <quality numslices="128"> brings the cylinder's polygonal approximation to 0.0015 % (with the default 28 the radius is 0.04 mm inside). Units m, mouth face at z = 0.
